class.name: TextureSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for texture filtering (anisotropic filtering, mipmap bias, projector and decal filter) and Canvas2D (texture filter, pixel snap, SDF, 2D shadow atlas).

method.name: add_viewport
method.description: Adds a further viewport (for example a [SubViewport] that renders the game world) that gets the per-viewport values at once and every later change, like the root viewport. The light projector filter, decal filter and canvas shadow atlas size are global, not per viewport. A freed viewport is dropped on its own. See also [method get_viewport_group].

method.name: get_anisotropic_filtering_level
method.description: Returns the pending anisotropic filtering level. See [member TextureSettings.anisotropic_filtering_level].

method.name: get_canvas_item_default_texture_filter
method.description: Returns the pending default canvas item texture filter. See [member TextureSettings.canvas_item_default_texture_filter].

method.name: get_canvas_item_default_texture_repeat
method.description: Returns the pending default canvas item texture repeat mode. See [member TextureSettings.canvas_item_default_texture_repeat].

method.name: get_canvas_shadow_atlas_size
method.description: Returns the pending canvas shadow atlas size. See [member TextureSettings.canvas_shadow_atlas_size].

method.name: get_decal_filter
method.description: Returns the pending decal filter. See [member TextureSettings.decal_filter].

method.name: get_light_projector_filter
method.description: Returns the pending light projector filter. See [member TextureSettings.light_projector_filter].

method.name: get_sdf_oversize
method.description: Returns the pending SDF oversize. See [member TextureSettings.sdf_oversize].

method.name: get_sdf_scale
method.description: Returns the pending SDF scale. See [member TextureSettings.sdf_scale].

method.name: get_texture_mipmap_bias
method.description: Returns the pending texture mipmap bias. See [member TextureSettings.texture_mipmap_bias].

method.name: get_unsupported_setting_names
method.description: Returns the names of the values the current renderer ignores, for example to gray out their options in a settings menu. See [method SettingsServer.is_value_supported].

method.name: get_viewport_group
method.description: Returns the group [code]&"texture_settings"[/code]. With [member viewport_target] [constant SettingsServer.VIEWPORT_TARGET_GROUP] (the default), every [Viewport] in this group gets the per-viewport values when it enters the tree and every later change while it is in the tree, without [method add_viewport].

method.name: has_viewport
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param viewport] was added with [method add_viewport].

method.name: is_renderer_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current renderer uses the value [param name]. Only [code]"light_projector_filter"[/code] and [code]"decal_filter"[/code] are unsupported, in the Compatibility renderer. Unlike [method SettingsServer.is_value_supported], it does not check that the domain has the value.

method.name: is_snap_2d_transforms_to_pixel_enabled
method.description: Returns the pending snapping of 2D transforms to pixels. See [member TextureSettings.snap_2d_transforms_to_pixel].

method.name: is_snap_2d_vertices_to_pixel_enabled
method.description: Returns the pending snapping of 2D vertices to pixels. See [member TextureSettings.snap_2d_vertices_to_pixel].

method.name: remove_viewport
method.description: Removes a viewport added with [method add_viewport]. It keeps its current values.

method.name: set_anisotropic_filtering_level
method.description: Sets the anisotropic filtering level (setting [code]"anisotropic_filtering_level"[/code]). See [member TextureSettings.anisotropic_filtering_level].

method.name: set_canvas_item_default_texture_filter
method.description: Sets the default canvas item texture filter (setting [code]"canvas_item_default_texture_filter"[/code]). See [member TextureSettings.canvas_item_default_texture_filter].

method.name: set_canvas_item_default_texture_repeat
method.description: Sets the default canvas item texture repeat mode (setting [code]"canvas_item_default_texture_repeat"[/code]). See [member TextureSettings.canvas_item_default_texture_repeat].

method.name: set_canvas_shadow_atlas_size

method.name: set_decal_filter

members.member: Which viewports get the per-viewport values besides the root viewport and the viewports added with [method add_viewport]: [constant SettingsServer.VIEWPORT_TARGET_GROUP] (the default) the viewports in the group [method get_viewport_group], [constant SettingsServer.VIEWPORT_TARGET_ALL_VIEWPORTS] every viewport in [ViewportServer], [constant SettingsServer.VIEWPORT_TARGET_ROOT_ONLY] no others. Viewports that enter the tree later get the values if they are targets. When the target changes, the viewports that are targets now get the current values at once; viewports that stop being targets keep the values they have. This is a choice of the game, not a player setting: it is not stored in the settings file. Set it in an autoload, for example. In the editor, [constant SettingsServer.VIEWPORT_TARGET_ALL_VIEWPORTS] also reaches the editor's own viewports.

signal.name: anisotropic_filtering_level_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member TextureSettings.anisotropic_filtering_level] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it for a [SubViewport] that renders the game.

signal.name: canvas_item_default_texture_filter_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member TextureSettings.canvas_item_default_texture_filter] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it for a [SubViewport] with 2D content.
